mission.title: Making rigorous economic analysis accessible
paragraphs: ÉconXStat is a firm whose goal is to provide quality services in economics and statistics, drawing on a network of internal and external experts.

Our activities fall into two main areas. On the one hand, we serve the professional world with economics and statistics consulting, always ensuring quality. On the other, to contribute to the academic world, we provide tutoring services to students, with close support that fosters their success.

hero.title: Privacy policy
hero.description: We protect your personal information in accordance with Québec's Law 25 and Canada's PIPEDA.

sections.title: Person responsible for personal information
sections.body: ÉconXStat is responsible for the personal information collected on this site. For any question or request, write to info@econxstat.ca.

sections.title: Information collected
sections.body: We only collect the information you voluntarily provide through the contact form: name, email address, organisation (optional), subject and the content of your message.

sections.title: Purposes
sections.body: This information is used solely to respond to your request and follow up on our exchanges. It is never sold or used for advertising.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
sections.body: This site uses no advertising cookies or tracking tools. A strictly functional cookie may remember your language and display theme preferences.

sections.title: Retention and security
sections.body: Your messages are kept only as long as needed to handle your request, then deleted. Connections to the site are encrypted (HTTPS) and access to data is limited to the relevant team members.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You may at any time request access to, correction or deletion of your information, or withdraw your consent, by writing to info@econxstat.ca. You may also file a complaint with the Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec.
